interface.name: OCCUPANCY_DETECTED
interface.description: Occupancy-detection result derived from the CO₂ sensor.

interface.name: ENERGY_SAVING_MODE
interface.description: TRUE selects energy saving; FALSE selects standard operation; affects Auto mode only.

interface.name: HVAC_MODE_SELECTOR
interface.description: 0 Auto, 1 Comfort, 2 Economy, 3 Night; callers supply a valid value.

scan_semantics: Inputs I[k] are sampled at invocation; outputs O[k] are observed after the call. Retained pre-state q[k] becomes q[k+1]. Each test resets the instance. A transition affects the same observed scan. dt_ms is elapsed time since the preceding invocation; the first invocation starts IEC timers at elapsed zero. CycleTime inputs, where supplied, are attributed to the current invocation rather than inferred from dt_ms.
safety_priority: Occupancy loss or Night immediately stops fan and resets delay.
Energy saving affects only Auto setback.
assumptions: Selector values are always 0..3 as required by the official input contract.
Outputs are initialized before the first call, which calculates adjustment immediately.
The timer starts at elapsed zero on the first non-Night occupied call. Fan starts at the first observation at or after 30s.
dt_ms is actual elapsed time since the preceding call; real runtime timer tests must preserve this timing.

formal_properties.name: Fan delay
formal_properties.explanation: Fan follows the complete uninterrupted delay.

formal_properties.name: Bounds
formal_properties.explanation: Legal outputs satisfy the required range.

formal_properties.name: Auto
formal_properties.explanation: Auto unoccupied setback follows energy saving.

formal_properties.name: Fixed modes
formal_properties.explanation: Comfort and Economy ignore energy saving.

formal_properties.name: Liveness
formal_properties.explanation: If permit stays TRUE from any scan onward, the fan eventually runs, assuming continued calls and diverging physical time.

atomic_propositions.auto_save: mode=0 AND NOT occupancy AND ENERGY_SAVING_MODE
atomic_propositions.auto_standard: mode=0 AND NOT occupancy AND NOT ENERGY_SAVING_MODE
